description: Report a site that is broken now — checkout failing, payments declined, a critical error, a white screen, locked out of wp-admin, an update that broke the site, a hack or a malware warning. Triaged the same day, within eight hours, weekends included, across European, US, Canadian and Australian hours. Submits immediately: there is no confirmation email to wait for, because friction on an emergency is friction in the wrong place. Ask the person before calling this, and send a real phone number — the reply comes by phone or WhatsApp.

email.description: Optional. If given, they get a written acknowledgement too.

message.description: What is happening, in their words. Include the exact error text if there is any.

phone.description: A number they can actually be reached on, with country code. The reply comes this way.

site.description: The address of the site that is broken.

name: submit_urgent_request
